markers.title: Red Light Racing
markers.objective: Start outside Mr. Wong's Laundrette in Chinatown/Red Light. Race against rival motorcyclists on a Sanchez.

markers.title: Torrington TT
markers.objective: Answer the payphone south of Belleville Park. High-speed motorbike race through the financial towers on a PCJ-600.

markers.title: Gangsta GP
markers.objective: Answer the payphone outside Liberty Pharmaceuticals in Pike Creek. Complete the three-lap motorcycle race in 1st place.

markers.title: Bumps & Grinds (Harwood Dirt Track)
markers.objective: Hop on the parked Sanchez at the dirt track. Complete 10 progressive motocross obstacle courses before the timer counts down to zero.
markers.reward: Sanchez and Manana spawn at Dirt Track, $1,500

markers.title: Low Rider Rumble
markers.objective: Answer the public payphone in Trenton. Race in a tuned low-rider vehicle and cross the finish line 1st.

markers.title: Deimos Dash
markers.objective: Answer the payphone south of Memorial Stadium in Aspatria. Outrun rival sports cars through Staunton Island.

markers.title: Wi-Cheetah Run
markers.objective: Answer the payphone in Wichita Gardens. Compete in high-speed sports car races across the twisty roads of Shoreside Vale.

markers.title: Scrapyard Challenge
markers.objective: Hop on the parked Sanchez by the junkyard building. Collect as many coronas across the obstacles as possible within 2 minutes.

markers.title: Wong Side of the Tracks
markers.objective: Mount the Sanchez at Baillie Station and race along the elevated train tracks before time expires.

markers.title: Go-Go Faggio Checkpoints
markers.objective: Ride the Faggio and pass through all 25 checkpoints before the timer expires.

markers.title: 9mm Mayhem
markers.location: Red Light District (Alley near Paulie's Revue Bar)
markers.objective: Mount the parked Freeway motorcycle. Toni will automatically aim and fire a 9mm pistol from the passenger seat as a driver navigates. Destroy the required target vehicles within the time limit.

markers.title: Scooter Shooter
markers.objective: Hop on the Faggio scooter. Shoot and destroy rival vehicles from the pillion seat with an SMG before the countdown reaches zero.

markers.title: AWOL Angel
markers.objective: Mount the Angel motorcycle in Wichita Gardens. Armed with an infinite-ammo M60 and adrenaline pills, eliminate renegade military soldiers within 3 minutes.

markers.title: Thrashing RC Buggies
markers.objective: Enter the parked TOYZ van in Hepburn Heights. Race miniature RC cars around the track and place 1st.

markers.title: Ragin' RC Buggies
markers.objective: Enter the TOYZ van near Belleville Park. Finish 1st in the RC buggy circuit race.

markers.title: Chasin' RC Buggies
markers.objective: Enter the TOYZ van in Wichita Gardens, Shoreside Vale. Complete the RC race in 1st position.

markers.title: RC Triad Take-Down
markers.objective: Step into the TOYZ van parked in Chinatown. Drive remote-controlled RC Bandits loaded with explosives into Triad gang members and detonate them. Eliminate at least 20 Triads.

markers.title: See the Sight Before Your Flight
markers.objective: Visit the information kiosk outside the airport terminal. Drive tourists to 12 iconic Liberty City landmarks and take photos before their flights depart.

markers.title: Slash TV (Chainsaw Survival)
markers.objective: Enter the dark cargo hull of the rusty freighter docked in Portland Harbor. Survive increasingly aggressive waves of masked chainsaw maniacs with only a chainsaw or melee weapon.
markers.reward: Cox Mascot Outfit at all safehouses, $1,500

markers.title: Paramedic (Level 12)
markers.objective: Enter the Ambulance outside Sweeney General Hospital and complete Level 12 in one continuous run to earn Infinite Sprint.

markers.title: Firefighter (Level 12)
markers.objective: Enter the Fire Truck outside Harwood Fire Station and extinguish 12 vehicle fires in a row to make Toni permanently fireproof.

markers.title: Pizza Delivery (Level 10)
markers.objective: Deliver pizzas on the Pizza Boy scooter behind Joe's Pizza up to Level 10 to increase health to 125.

markers.title: Noodle Delivery (Level 10)
markers.objective: Deliver noodles on the Noodle Faggio in Chinatown up to Level 10 to increase health to 150.

markers.title: Car Salesman (Level 6)
markers.reward: $4,000/day asset at Capital Autos, Hellenbach GT
markers.objective: Sell 4 of each vehicle category (Fast, Normal, Tough, Cheap) up to Level 6 to turn Capital Autos into a cash asset.

markers.title: Trash Dash — Portland
markers.objective: Drive the Trashmaster around Portland and empty all green dumpsters before time expires.

markers.title: Trash Dash — Staunton Island
markers.objective: Drive the Trashmaster parked behind Carson General Hospital in Rockford and empty all dumpsters before time expires.

markers.title: Trash Dash — Shoreside Vale
markers.objective: Drive the Trashmaster around Shoreside Vale to collect all dumpsters within the time limit.

markers.title: Avenging Angels — Portland (15 Levels)
markers.reward: $1,500, Avenger motorcycle at Saint Mark's Safehouse
markers.objective: Wear the Avenging Angels fatigues, recruit partners, and eliminate gang crime up to Level 15 on Portland.

markers.title: Avenging Angels — Staunton Island (15 Levels)
markers.objective: Wear the Avenging Angels fatigues and clear 15 levels of street criminals on Staunton Island.

markers.title: Avenging Angels — Shoreside Vale (15 Levels)
markers.reward: $1,500, Hero Garb Outfit at all safehouses
markers.objective: Wear the Avenging Angels fatigues and clear 15 levels of criminals on Shoreside Vale.
